sam (prod-eng): heads up — deploy-bot just surfaced a compatibility signal between runtime v3.2.0 and sdk 1.6.0 on long-seq workloads. thinking we should soft-pin runtime back to 3.1.4 while we triage? :thinking:

deploy-bot: [AUTO] pin-request created by sam (prod-eng) at 2024-11-30T15:12:01Z. Target: runtime v3.1.4 for route: /models/* (canary + prod). Reason: sdk 1.6.0 regressions for long sequences. Link: https://deploy.internal/pins/PR-4821

carla (runtime): what failures are we seeing? can you paste a failing log/sample?

elaine (qa): reproducer from canary attached. quick log excerpt:
```
2024-11-30T15:05:10Z model-serving[pid=8421]: kv_cache_lookup: mismatch length=4096 expected=4092
2024-11-30T15:05:10Z model-serving[pid=8421]: runtime error: kv-cache offset out of range
```
this causes token stream aborts ~10% of long requests.

carla (runtime): hmm looks like a layout/stride change in how KV frames are serialized. did sdk 1.6 change the on-disk/over-the-wire format?

dinesh (sdk): yes — sdk 1.6 switched to compacted KV frames to save memory. we missed a backward compatibility flag for runtimes <3.2.1. sorry, my bad. the SDK has a compatibility shim but runtime needs a tiny patch.

sam (prod-eng): ok — two paths: 1) soft-pin runtime to 3.1.4 for 6h change window and push a 3.2.1 runtime patch and canary, or 2) roll sdk back to 1.5.x (slower, touches many microservices). preference for pin + patch. thoughts?

jonas (oncall): pin is less blast-radius, agreed. need to confirm Dedicated clusters — pin propagation should reach all fleets (hosted + dedicated control plane) but we should notify enterprise customers.

carla (runtime): i can cut 3.2.1 with the compatibility fix (one-line change). i'll open PR now and run quick canary preflight. estimate 45m.

dinesh (sdk): i'll put up a short blurb in the sdk release notes and add a fallback flag `--kv-compat` we can flip if anything weird shows in canary.

elaine (qa): re: tests — i'll rerun long-seq e2e against 3.1.4 pin in canary and validate token continuity. if green, we can pin immediately. ETA 20m.

sam (prod-eng): deploy-bot — please apply soft-pin to runtime route and schedule an unblock at +6h. include a comment: "temporary pin due to sdk 1.6 incompat with runtimes <3.2.1; follow-on: runtime 3.2.1 rollout."

deploy-bot: action=apply_pin user=sam target=runtime:v3.1.4 scope=routes:/models/* mode=soft expires_in=6h comment="temp pin: sdk 1.6 incompat for long-seq" status=success id=pin-9876

elaine (qa): canary run on pinned runtime looks good so far — 0/240 long-seq requests failed in the last 10m.

carla (runtime): PR #5778 opened: fix kv frame layout + unit + canary job. will merge on green. rolling 3.2.1 canary as soon as it's merged.

dinesh (sdk): pushed sdk note and added `--kv-compat` flag. I'll coordinate with carla if we need to flip it during canary.

jonas (oncall): customer communication: i'll draft a short notice for active Dedicated customers impacted by pin. pinging account teams.

sam (prod-eng): summary: applied soft-pin to runtime v3.1.4 across routes, QE validating, runtime patch 3.2.1 in flight, unpin scheduled in 6h pending rollforward. if 3.2.1 passes canary, we'll unpin and roll. thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: pin-9876 will auto-expire at 2024-11-30T21:12:01Z unless extended or removed manually.
